verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product. The closest feature is "Fix with cubic", a one-click targeted fix for a single review comment that is pushed to the PR branch. That is an adjacent review-remediation feature, not delegation of longer-running coding tasks. Nothing in the evidence describes a background task agent or an isolated cloud execution environment. Ultrareview and codebase scans are long-running analyses, not coding-task execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
